discovery_candidate_rule.eligible_candidates: only candidates mechanically implied by each already-frozen Grammar 007 semantic preregistration; no threshold/window/lookback/target grid and no performance-based source selection
discovery_candidate_rule.direction: absolute standardized effect; retain observed sign for validation
discovery_candidate_rule.ranking: largest absolute standardized effect on the sealed discovery partition

pass_if_all: candidate effect has same sign as discovery
absolute validation effect >= 0.50 * absolute discovery effect
validation effect is computable on the sealed validation partition
candidate effect has same sign as discovery
absolute holdout effect >= 0.50 * absolute discovery effect
holdout effect is computable on the sealed holdout partition
